text.traditional: 家豪，你手裡拿的是什麼？是健康檢查的簡介嗎？
text.simplified: 家豪，你手里拿的是什么？是健康检查的简介吗？
text.pinyin: Jiāháo, nǐ shǒulǐ ná de shì shénme? Shì jiànkāngjiǎnchá de jiǎnjiè ma?
text.english: Jiahao, what are you holding in your hand? Is it a brochure for health examinations?

text.traditional: 對啊，早上陪我阿姨去醫院辦理住院手續時，順便拿的，要帶回去給我爸媽看。
text.simplified: 对啊，早上陪我阿姨去医院办理住院手续时，顺便拿的，要带回去给我爸妈看。
text.pinyin: Duì a, zǎoshàng péi wǒ āyí qù yīyuàn bànlǐ zhùyuàn shǒuxù shí, shùnbiàn ná de, yào dài huí qù gěi wǒ bà mā kàn.
text.english: Yes. I picked it up this morning while accompanying my aunt to handle her hospital admission, to take home for my parents to see.

text.traditional: 你阿姨怎麼了？昨天我還在超市遇到她，看起來很健康啊！
text.simplified: 你阿姨怎么了？昨天我还在超市遇到她，看起来很健康啊！
text.pinyin: Nǐ āyí zěnmele? Zuótiān wǒ hái zài chāoshì yùdào tā, kànqǐlái hěn jiànkāng a!
text.english: What happened to your aunt? I just ran into her at the supermarket yesterday and she looked in great health!

text.traditional: 說也奇怪，她一向都有良好的飲食和生活習慣，也從來沒發覺自己有什麼毛病。直到上個月做了全身健康檢查，才知道病了。
text.simplified: 说也奇怪，她一向都有良好的饮食和生活习惯，也从来没发觉自己有什么毛病。直到上个月做了全身健康检查，才知道病了。
text.pinyin: Shuō yě qíguài, tā yíxiàng dōu yǒu liánghǎo de yǐnshí hé shēnghuó xíguàn, yě cónglái méi fājué zìjǐ yǒu shénme máobìng. Zhídào shàng ge yuè zuò le quánshēn jiànkāngjiǎnchá, cái zhīdào bìng le.
text.english: Strange to say, she has always maintained healthy dietary and living habits, and never sensed anything wrong. Not until she underwent a comprehensive health check last month did she realize she was ill.

text.traditional: 每次聽你阿姨說話，都感覺她只想著照顧家人，自己一定沒想到會變成病人吧？
text.simplified: 每次听你阿姨说话，都感觉她只想着照顾家人，自己一定没想到会变成病人吧？
text.pinyin: Měicì tīng nǐ āyí shuōhuà, dōu gǎnjué tā zhǐ xiǎng zhe zhàogù jiārén, zìjǐ yídìng méixiǎngdào huì biànchéng bìngrén ba?
text.english: Whenever I hear your aunt speak, I feel she only ever thinks of looking after her family; she certainly never imagined becoming a patient herself.

text.traditional: 是啊，她是家庭主婦，生活很單純，每天管孩子、注意家人的健康，照顧家人就是她生活的重心，從沒想過自己也需要別人照顧。
text.simplified: 是啊，她是家庭主妇，生活很单纯，每天管孩子、注意家人的健康，照顾家人就是她生活的重心，从没想过自己也需要别人照顾。
text.pinyin: Shì a, tā shì jiātíng zhǔfù, shēnghuó hěn dānchún, měitiān guǎn háizi, zhùyì jiārén de jiànkāng, zhàogù jiārén jiùshì tā shēnghuó de zhòngxīn, cóngméi xiǎng guò zìjǐ yě xūyào biérén zhàogù.
text.english: Yes. She's a homemaker and her life is simple: every day she looks after the kids and keeps an eye on the family's health. Taking care of her family is the center of her life, and she has never thought that she might need others to take care of her too.

text.traditional: 不過還好她去做了健檢，才知道該去看醫生。
text.simplified: 不过还好她去做了健检，才知道该去看医生。
text.pinyin: Búguò háihǎo tā qù zuò le jiànjiǎn, cái zhīdào gāi qù kàn yīshēng.
text.english: Still, it's fortunate she went for the checkup; only then did she know to see a doctor.

text.traditional: 妳說的沒錯。我早就想帶父母去做了，只不過他們覺得做健檢除了得花時間，還很麻煩，所以很被動，我得趁這個機會，跟他們溝通一下。
text.simplified: 你说的没错。我早就想带父母去做了，只不过他们觉得做健检除了得花时间，还很麻烦，所以很被动，我得趁这个机会，跟他们沟通一下。
text.pinyin: Nǐ shuō de méicuò. Wǒ zǎojiù xiǎng dài fùmǔ qù zuò le, zhǐbúguò tāmen juéde zuò jiànjiǎn chúle děi huā shíjiān, hái hěn máfán, suǒyǐ hěn bèidòng, wǒ děi chèn zhè ge jīhuì, gēn tāmen gōutōng yíxià.
text.english: You're right. I've wanted to take my parents for a checkup for a long time; it's just that they feel that, besides taking time, it's a lot of hassle, so they're very passive about it. I must seize this opportunity to talk with them.

text.traditional: 我先生也一樣。最近他頭痛了好幾天，我想帶他去看病，他不但不配合，反而很生氣地說：「我又沒什麼毛病，為什麼非去不可！」他死也不肯去，害我擔心得不得了。
text.simplified: 我先生也一样。最近他头痛了好几天，我想带他去看病，他不但不配合，反而很生气地说：「我又没什么毛病，为什么非去不可！」他死也不肯去，害我担心得不得了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiānshēng yě yíyàng. Zuìjìn tā tóutòng le hǎojǐ tiān, wǒ xiǎng dài tā qù kànbìng, tā búdàn bú pèihé, fǎn'ér hěn shēngqì de shuō: “Wǒ yòu méishénme máobìng, wèishénme fēi qù bùkě!” Tā sǐ yě bù kěn qù, hài wǒ dānxīn de bùdéliǎo.
text.english: My husband is just the same. He had headaches for several days recently, and when I wanted to take him to the clinic, far from cooperating, he snapped angrily: 'Nothing is wrong with me, why must I go!' He obstinately refused, causing me tremendous worry.

text.traditional: 如果感覺這麼不舒服，就是身體發出警告，表示健康有問題了。我看妳陪他去醫院，妳也順便做個免費的基本健檢吧。
text.simplified: 如果感觉这么不舒服，就是身体发出警告，表示健康有问题了。我看你陪他去医院，你也顺便做个免费的基本健检吧。
text.pinyin: Rúguǒ gǎnjué zhème bù shūfu, jiùshì shēntǐ fāchū jǐnggào, biǎoshì jiànkāng yǒu wèntí le. Wǒ kàn nǐ péi tā qù yīyuàn, nǐ yě shùnbiàn zuò ge miǎnfèi de jīběn jiànjiǎn ba.
text.english: If he feels that uncomfortable, that's his body sending a warning that something is wrong with his health. I suggest you accompany him to the hospital, and take advantage of a free basic checkup yourself.

text.traditional: 免費健檢的對象，好像年齡得滿四十歲。我還年輕呢！
text.simplified: 免费健检的对象，好像年龄得满四十岁。我还年轻呢！
text.pinyin: Miǎnfèi jiànjiǎn de duìxiàng, hǎoxiàng niánlíng děi mǎn sìshí suì. Wǒ hái niánqīng ne!
text.english: It seems you have to be at least forty to get a free checkup. I'm still young!

text.traditional: 對不起，對不起。
text.simplified: 对不起，对不起。
text.pinyin: Duìbùqǐ, duìbùqǐ.
text.english: My apologies, sorry about that.

text.traditional: 沒什麼啦！
text.simplified: 没什么啦！
text.pinyin: Méishénme la!
text.english: No worries at all!

text.traditional: （家豪看了一下手上的簡介）
text.simplified: （家豪看了一下手上的简介）
text.pinyin: (Jiāháo kàn le yíxià shǒu shàng de jiǎnjiè)
text.english: (Jiahao glances at the brochure in his hand.)

text.traditional: 這家醫院的醫生挺有名的，應該很可靠，健檢手續也不麻煩，只要上網填個表就行了。
text.simplified: 这家医院的医生挺有名的，应该很可靠，健检手续也不麻烦，只要上网填个表就行了。
text.pinyin: Zhè jiā yīyuàn de yīshēng tǐng yǒumíng de, yīnggāi hěn kěkào, jiànjiǎn shǒuxù yě bù máfán, zhǐyào shàngwǎng tián ge biǎo jiù xíng le.
text.english: The doctors at this hospital are quite renowned and should be dependable; checkup procedures aren't complicated either—just fill out an online form.

text.traditional: 我最大的願望就是家人都健健康康的。既然手續這麼簡單，那明天就先帶我先生去做個健檢吧。
text.simplified: 我最大的愿望就是家人都健健康康的。既然手续这么简单，那明天就先带我先生去做个健检吧。
text.pinyin: Wǒ zuì dà de yuànwàng jiùshì jiārén dōu jiànjiàn kāngkāng de. Jìrán shǒuxù zhème jiǎndān, nà míngtiān jiù xiān dài wǒ xiānshēng qù zuò ge jiànjiǎn ba.
text.english: My greatest wish is for my family to stay completely healthy. Since the procedure is that simple, tomorrow I'll take my husband for a checkup first.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that something did not happen until a certain time or event, later than expected, with 直到……才…….
grammarPages.explanation: 表示過去一直沒發生的事情，到了某個時間點才發生。「直到」後面接時間或情況。「才」後面接結果，表示說話的人覺得比預期的晚。
grammarPages.pattern: 直到 + Time / Event (+ 以後/時) + Subject + 才 + Result

text.traditional: ……從來沒發覺自己有什麼毛病。直到上個月做了全身健康檢查，才知道病了。
text.simplified: ……从来没发觉自己有什么毛病。直到上个月做了全身健康检查，才知道病了。
text.pinyin: …Cónglái méi fājué zìjǐ yǒu shénme máobìng. Zhídào shàng ge yuè zuò le quánshēn jiànkāngjiǎnchá, cái zhīdào bìng le.
text.english: …She had never noticed any health problems of her own. Not until a full checkup last month did she learn she was ill.

text.traditional: 小王大學畢業後一直找不到好工作，直到三十歲才找到合適的。
text.simplified: 小王大学毕业后一直找不到好工作，直到三十岁才找到合适的。
text.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng dàxué bìyè hòu yìzhí zhǎobúdào hǎo gōngzuò, zhídào sānshí suì cái zhǎodào héshì de.
text.english: After graduating from college, Xiao Wang couldn't find a good job for a long time. He didn't find a suitable one until he was thirty.

text.traditional: 因為早上起床起晚了，直到飛機起飛前三十分鐘，我才趕到機場。
text.simplified: 因为早上起床起晚了，直到飞机起飞前三十分钟，我才赶到机场。
text.pinyin: Yīnwèi zǎoshàng qǐchuáng qǐ wǎn le, zhídào fēijī qǐfēi qián sānshí fēnzhōng, wǒ cái gǎndào jīchǎng.
text.english: Because I got up late this morning, I didn't make it to the airport until thirty minutes before takeoff.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 直到……（，）才…… means that what has not occurred will not happen until after a certain point in time. 直到 is followed by time or circumstances. 才 is followed by the result, which means that the speaker felt that the result was later than expected.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: It's Just That … with 只不過
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Add a small 'but' or an extra detail to what you just said with 只不過 (it's just that…).
grammarPages.explanation: 「只不過」是「只是」的意思，用來補充說明某件事，讓聽者更了解事情的情況。「只不過」的後面接要補充說明的內容。

text.traditional: 我早就想帶父母去做了，只不過他們覺得做健檢除了得花時間……
text.simplified: 我早就想带父母去做了，只不过他们觉得做健检除了得花时间……
text.pinyin: Wǒ zǎojiù xiǎng dài fùmǔ qù zuò le, zhǐbúguò tāmen juéde zuò jiànjiǎn chúle děi huā shíjiān…
text.english: I've wanted to take my parents for a checkup for a long time; it's just that they feel that, besides taking time, a checkup…

text.traditional: 我很喜歡這輛英國車，只不過價格太高了，我得多存一點錢才買得起。
text.simplified: 我很喜欢这辆英国车，只不过价格太高了，我得多存一点钱才买得起。
text.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐhuān zhè liàng Yīngguó chē, zhǐbúguò jiàgé tài gāo le, wǒ děi duō cún yìdiǎn qián cái mǎi de qǐ.
text.english: I really like this British car; it's just that the price is too high. I have to save more money before I can afford it.

text.traditional: 他很想當背包客去非洲旅行，只不過公司的事情太多，實在走不開。
text.simplified: 他很想当背包客去非洲旅行，只不过公司的事情太多，实在走不开。
text.pinyin: Tā hěn xiǎng dāng bēibāokè qù Fēizhōu lǚxíng, zhǐbúguò gōngsī de shìqíng tài duō, shízài zǒu bù kāi.
text.english: He'd really like to go backpacking in Africa; it's just that he has too much to do at work and really can't get away.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 只不過 has the same meaning as 只是, which is used to supplement something and let the listener know more about the situation. 只不過 is followed by the supplementary explanation.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say that someone or something caused a bad result for someone, using 害.
grammarPages.explanation: 這個「害」有「讓」或「使」的意思，語氣比較強烈。「害」的後面接負面的結果。
grammarPages.pattern: Cause / Subject + 害 + Victim / Object + Negative Result

text.traditional: ……他死也不肯去，害我擔心得不得了。
text.simplified: ……他死也不肯去，害我担心得不得了。
text.pinyin: …Tā sǐ yě bù kěn qù, hài wǒ dānxīn de bùdéliǎo.
text.english: …He flatly refused to go, which made me terribly worried.

text.traditional: 周先生爬山時迷了路，山上很偏僻，手機的訊號很弱，害他沒辦法跟家人聯絡。
text.simplified: 周先生爬山时迷了路，山上很偏僻，手机的讯号很弱，害他没办法跟家人联络。
text.pinyin: Zhōu xiānshēng páshān shí mí le lù, shān shàng hěn piānpì, shǒujī de xùnhào hěn ruò, hài tā méibànfǎ gēn jiārén liánluò.
text.english: Mr. Zhou got lost while hiking. The mountain was very remote and his phone signal was weak, which left him unable to contact his family.

text.traditional: 要是老師每天要求學生寫很多測驗題目，不僅對學習沒好處，也會害他們更討厭讀書。
text.simplified: 要是老师每天要求学生写很多测验题目，不仅对学习没好处，也会害他们更讨厌读书。
text.pinyin: Yàoshì lǎoshī měitiān yāoqiú xuéshēng xiě hěn duō cèyàn tímù, bù jǐn duì xuéxí méi hǎochù, yě huì hài tāmen gèng tǎoyàn dúshū.
text.english: If teachers make students do lots of test questions every day, not only will it not help their learning, it will also make them hate studying even more.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: This 害 has the meaning of 讓 or 使, but the tone is stronger. 害 is followed by a negative result.

dialogue.title: 短文 · 追求健康與幸福的生活

text.traditional: 家豪的伯伯林水木是一家玩具工廠的大老闆，工作三十年了。雖然這段期間遇到了不少挫折，但是他很堅強，為了給家人安定的生活、當員工的榜樣，他都努力克服、堅持到底，終於擁有了今天的成就。
text.simplified: 家豪的伯伯林水木是一家玩具工厂的大老板，工作三十年了。虽然这段期间遇到了不少挫折，但是他很坚强，为了给家人安定的生活、当员工的榜样，他都努力克服、坚持到底，终于拥有了今天的成就。
text.pinyin: Jiāháo de bóbo Lín Shuǐmù shì yì jiā wánjù gōngchǎng de dà lǎobǎn, gōngzuò sānshí nián le. Suīrán zhè duàn qíjiān yùdào le bùshǎo cuòzhé, dànshì tā hěn jiānqiáng, wèile gěi jiārén āndìng de shēnghuó, dāng yuángōng de bǎngyàng, tā dōu nǔlì kèfú, jiānchí dàodǐ, zhōngyú yǒngyǒu le jīntiān de chéngjiù.
text.english: Jiahao's uncle Lin Shuimu is the owner of a toy factory, where he has worked for thirty years. Although encountering numerous setbacks over this period, he remained steadfast; to provide stability for his family and serve as a model for employees, he persevered through difficulties to the very end, finally achieving today's success.

text.traditional: 過去三十年，林伯伯不但經常到各部門了解情況，對產品標準的要求也較高。他認為自己是公司的主角，要是少了他，銷售成績一定不理想。在家豪的記憶中，伯伯每天的生活就像打仗一樣，老是忙得忘了吃飯，有時緊張得睡不著。有一次他跟部門主管開會，因為討論得太激烈，頭突然痛得不得了，連站都站不起來，助理立刻送他到醫院去。
text.simplified: 过去三十年，林伯伯不但经常到各部门了解情况，对产品标准的要求也较高。他认为自己是公司的主角，要是少了他，销售成绩一定不理想。在家豪的记忆中，伯伯每天的生活就像打仗一样，老是忙得忘了吃饭，有时紧张得睡不着。有一次他跟部门主管开会，因为讨论得太激烈，头突然痛得不得了，连站都站不起来，助理立刻送他到医院去。
text.pinyin: Guòqù sānshí nián, Lín bóbo búdàn jīngcháng dào gè bùmén liǎojiě qíngkuàng, duì chǎnpǐn biāozhǔn de yāoqiú yě jiào gāo. Tā rènwéi zìjǐ shì gōngsī de zhǔjiǎo, yàoshì shǎo le tā, xiāoshòu chéngjī yídìng bù lǐxiǎng. Zài Jiāháo de jìyì zhōng, bóbo měitiān de shēnghuó jiù xiàng dǎzhàng yíyàng, lǎoshì máng de wàngle chīfàn, yǒu shí jǐnzhāng de shuì bùzháo. Yǒu yí cì tā gēn bùmén zhǔguǎn kāihuì, yīnwèi tǎolùn de tài jīliè, tóu túrán tòng de bùdéliǎo, lián zhàn dōu zhàn bù qǐlái, zhùlǐ lìkè sòng tā dào yīyuàn qù.
text.english: Over the past thirty years, Uncle Lin not only inspected departments regularly, but maintained demanding product standards. He viewed himself as the key figure in the company, believing sales would suffer without him. In Jiahao's memory, his uncle lived every day like a battle, constantly too busy to eat, and sometimes too stressed to sleep. Once, during a meeting with his department managers, the discussion got so heated that he suddenly had a terrible headache and couldn't even stand up, and his assistant immediately took him to the hospital.

text.traditional: 醫生告訴林伯伯，想要早日恢復健康，除了調整生活作息，還要培養符合健康的飲食習慣。比如每天早睡早起、按時間吃飯、運動三十分鐘，避免吃太鹹、太油的食物。他也一再警告林伯伯，別拿生命開玩笑，假如不改變過去的生活方式，恐怕連上帝也救不了了。
text.simplified: 医生告诉林伯伯，想要早日恢复健康，除了调整生活作息，还要培养符合健康的饮食习惯。比如每天早睡早起、按时间吃饭、运动三十分钟，避免吃太咸、太油的食物。他也一再警告林伯伯，别拿生命开玩笑，假如不改变过去的生活方式，恐怕连上帝也救不了了。
text.pinyin: Yīshēng gàosu Lín bóbo, xiǎngyào zǎorì huīfù jiànkāng, chúle tiáozhěng shēnghuó zuòxí, háiyào péiyǎng fúhé jiànkāng de yǐnshí xíguàn. Bǐrú měitiān zǎoshuì zǎoqǐ, àn shíjiān chīfàn, yùndòng sānshí fēnzhōng, bìmiǎn chī tài xián, tài yóu de shíwù. Tā yě yízài jǐnggào Lín bóbo, bié ná shēngmìng kāiwánxiào, jiǎrú bù gǎibiàn guòqù de shēnghuó fāngshì, kǒngpà lián Shàngdì yě jiù bùliǎo le.
text.english: The doctor advised Uncle Lin that regaining health required adjusting daily schedules and cultivating balanced diet habits: sleeping early and rising early, eating meals on time, exercising thirty minutes daily, and avoiding overly salty or greasy fare. He also warned Uncle Lin again and again not to gamble with his life: if he didn't change his old way of life, he was afraid even God wouldn't be able to save him.

text.traditional: 最初，林伯伯不太能適應這樣的改變，要是覺得食物的味道太淡，還是會加一些醬料；為了多運動，每天走路去上班，但經常走到一半就沒體力了，只好搭計程車。最後家人不得不一起來協助他，陪他吃飯、運動，甚至走路上下班。還好經過了一段時間，林伯伯終於恢復健康，不再教家人擔心了。
text.simplified: 最初，林伯伯不太能适应这样的改变，要是觉得食物的味道太淡，还是会加一些酱料；为了多运动，每天走路去上班，但经常走到一半就没体力了，只好搭计程车。最后家人不得不一起来协助他，陪他吃饭、运动，甚至走路上下班。还好经过了一段时间，林伯伯终于恢复健康，不再教家人担心了。
text.pinyin: Zuìchū, Lín bóbo bú tài néng shìyìng zhèyàng de gǎibiàn, yàoshì juéde shíwù de wèidào tài dàn, háishì huì jiā yìxiē jiàngliào; wèile duō yùndòng, měitiān zǒulù qù shàngbān, dàn jīngcháng zǒu dào yíbàn jiù méi tǐlì le, zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē. Zuìhòu jiārén bùdébù yìqǐ lái xiézhù tā, péi tā chīfàn, yùndòng, shènzhì zǒulù shàng xiàbān. Háihǎo jīngguò le yí duàn shíjiān, Lín bóbo zhōngyú huīfù jiànkāng, búzài jiào jiārén dānxīn le.
text.english: Initially, Uncle Lin struggled with the shift: when food tasted bland he still added sauces; to exercise he walked to work, but frequently ran out of steam halfway and hailed a taxi. In the end, his family had no choice but to help him, sharing meals, exercising, and even walking commutes together. Fortunately, after a while Uncle Lin recovered his health, bringing peace of mind back to his family.

text.traditional: 就在林伯伯為了健康而努力時，他的一位老朋友因為工作太累，僅僅五十歲就不幸去世了。這個壞消息給了林伯伯很大的刺激，讓他重新思考努力工作到底是為了什麼，真正的幸福又是什麼。或許，誰都找不到正確的答案，不過健康一定是最重要的。
text.simplified: 就在林伯伯为了健康而努力时，他的一位老朋友因为工作太累，仅仅五十岁就不幸去世了。这个坏消息给了林伯伯很大的刺激，让他重新思考努力工作到底是为了什么，真正的幸福又是什么。或许，谁都找不到正确的答案，不过健康一定是最重要的。
text.pinyin: Jiù zài Lín bóbo wèile jiànkāng ér nǔlì shí, tā de yí wèi lǎo péngyǒu yīnwèi gōngzuò tài lèi, jǐnjǐn wǔshí suì jiù búxìng qùshì le. Zhè ge huài xiāoxí gěi le Lín bóbo hěn dà de cìjī, ràng tā chóngxīn sīkǎo nǔlì gōngzuò dàodǐ shì wèile shénme, zhēnzhèng de xìngfú yòu shì shénme. Huòxǔ, shéi dōu zhǎobúdào zhèngquè de dá'àn, búguò jiànkāng yídìng shì zuì zhòngyào de.
text.english: Just as Uncle Lin was striving for health, an old friend of his passed away at merely fifty years old from work exhaustion. This somber news dealt him a profound shock, causing him to reevaluate what relentless work is ultimately for, and what true happiness really means. Perhaps nobody has definitive answers, but good health is certainly paramount.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Carrying Through to the End with V到底
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Emphasize persevering, pursuing, or seeing an action through to the very end.
grammarPages.explanation: 強調某件事做到最後，或堅持、努力到最後。

text.traditional: ……他都努力克服、堅持到底，終於擁有了今天的成就。
text.simplified: ……他都努力克服、坚持到底，终于拥有了今天的成就。
text.pinyin: …Tā dōu nǔlì kèfú, jiānchí dàodǐ, zhōngyú yǒngyǒu le jīntiān de chéngjiù.
text.english: …he worked hard to overcome every setback and stuck with it to the end, finally achieving the success he has today.

text.traditional: 既然我答應要幫你，就一定會幫到底的，請放心。
text.simplified: 既然我答应要帮你，就一定会帮到底的，请放心。
text.pinyin: Jìrán wǒ dāyìng yào bāng nǐ, jiù yídìng huì bāng dàodǐ de, qǐng fàngxīn.
text.english: Since I promised to help you, I'll definitely help you all the way to the end. Don't worry.

text.traditional: 這個工作是你自己決定要做的，必須負責到底，不可以碰到麻煩就不做了。
text.simplified: 这个工作是你自己决定要做的，必须负责到底，不可以碰到麻烦就不做了。
text.pinyin: Zhège gōngzuò shì nǐ zìjǐ juédìng yào zuò de, bìxū fùzé dàodǐ, bù kěyǐ pèngdào máfán jiù bú zuò le.
text.english: You decided to do this job yourself, so you have to take responsibility for it to the end. You can't just quit as soon as you run into trouble.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: V 到底 emphasizes that something is carried out to the end, persistently and diligently.

grammarPages.learnerPromise: Describe actions, warnings, or appeals that recur again and again with 一再.
grammarPages.explanation: 表示某個動作或事情一次又一次地發生。

text.traditional: 他也一再警告林伯伯，別拿生命開玩笑……
text.simplified: 他也一再警告林伯伯，别拿生命开玩笑……
text.pinyin: Tā yě yízài jǐnggào Lín bóbo, bié ná shēngmìng kāiwánxiào…
text.english: He also warned Uncle Lin again and again not to gamble with his life…

text.traditional: 李先生上班一再遲到，直到老闆叫他明天起別來了，他才知道事情有多麼嚴重。
text.simplified: 李先生上班一再迟到，直到老板叫他明天起别来了，他才知道事情有多么严重。
text.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng shàngbān yízài chídào, zhídào lǎobǎn jiào tā míngtiān qǐ bié lái le, tā cái zhīdào shìqíng yǒu duóme yánzhòng.
text.english: Mr. Li was late for work again and again. Not until his boss told him not to come in anymore starting tomorrow did he realize how serious things were.

text.traditional: 選舉時市長一再向民眾強調，當選後一定會好好改善交通情況，但沒想到現在反而更嚴重了。
text.simplified: 选举时市长一再向民众强调，当选后一定会好好改善交通情况，但没想到现在反而更严重了。
text.pinyin: Xuǎnjǔ shí shìzhǎng yízài xiàng mínzhòng qiángdiào, dāngxuǎn hòu yídìng huì hǎohǎo gǎishàn jiāotōng qíngkuàng, dàn méixiǎngdào xiànzài fǎn'ér gèng yánzhòng le.
text.english: During the election, the mayor stressed to the public again and again that once elected, he would definitely improve traffic. Unexpectedly, it has now become even worse instead.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: 一再 indicates that a certain action has taken place or an event has occurred again and again.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Saying 'If' in Writing with 假如
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Say 'if' or 'suppose' with 假如, mostly in writing, placing it before the subject.
grammarPages.explanation: 「假如」跟「如果」、「要是」一樣，用來假設某個條件或情況，常和「就」搭配使用，表示在假設條件或情況下發生的結果。「如果」可用在主語前後，可用於書面、口語；「要是」也可用在主語前後，但僅用於口語；「假如」用在主語前，多用於書面。
grammarPages.pattern: 假如 + Condition, + (Subject) + 就 / 恐怕 + Result

text.traditional: ……假如不改變過去的生活方式，恐怕連上帝也救不了了。
text.simplified: ……假如不改变过去的生活方式，恐怕连上帝也救不了了。
text.pinyin: …Jiǎrú bù gǎibiàn guòqù de shēnghuó fāngshì, kǒngpà lián Shàngdì yě jiù bùliǎo le.
text.english: …If he doesn't change his old way of life, I'm afraid even God won't be able to save him.

text.traditional: 假如你對自己的穿著品味沒有信心，可以多看服裝雜誌或聽聽專櫃小姐的意見。
text.simplified: 假如你对自己的穿着品味没有信心，可以多看服装杂志或听听专柜小姐的意见。
text.pinyin: Jiǎrú nǐ duì zìjǐ de chuānzhuó pǐnwèi méiyǒu xìnxīn, kěyǐ duō kàn fúzhuāng zázhì huò tīng tīng zhuānguì xiǎojiě de yìjiàn.
text.english: If you're not confident about your taste in clothes, you can read more fashion magazines or listen to the advice of the salespeople at the brand counters.

text.traditional: 他是個有耐心、做事認真的人，假如讓他負責推銷新產品，應該會有不錯的成果。
text.simplified: 他是个有耐心、做事认真的人，假如让他负责推销新产品，应该会有不错的成果。
text.pinyin: Tā shì ge yǒu nàixīn, zuòshì rènzhēn de rén, jiǎrú ràng tā fùzé tuīxiāo xīn chǎnpǐn, yīnggāi huì yǒu búcuò de chéngguǒ.
text.english: He's a patient person who takes his work seriously. If we put him in charge of selling the new products, the results should be quite good.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: As with 如果 and 要是, 假如 is used to assume a certain condition or situation. The following sentence is often used in conjunction with 就 to indicate the result of a hypothetical condition or situation. 如果 can be used before and after the subject, both written and spoken. 要是 can also be used before and after the subject, but only in spoken Chinese; 假如 is used before the subject in written Chinese.

grammarPages.titleEnglish: Purpose and Action with 為了……而……
grammarPages.learnerPromise: Link a goal (為了……) with what someone does to reach it (而……).
grammarPages.explanation: 「為了」之後的短語說明要達到的目標，「而」後面的短語說明為了達到目標所做的事情。
grammarPages.pattern: Subject + 為了 + Goal + 而 + Action

text.traditional: 就在林伯伯為了健康而努力時，他的一位老朋友因為工作太累……
text.simplified: 就在林伯伯为了健康而努力时，他的一位老朋友因为工作太累……
text.pinyin: Jiù zài Lín bóbo wèile jiànkāng ér nǔlì shí, tā de yí wèi lǎo péngyǒu yīnwèi gōngzuò tài lèi…
text.english: Right when Uncle Lin was striving for his health, an old friend of his, worn out from work…

text.traditional: 他為了挑戰臺灣最高的高山，而每天慢跑一小時，訓練自己的體力。
text.simplified: 他为了挑战台湾最高的高山，而每天慢跑一小时，训练自己的体力。
text.pinyin: Tā wèile tiǎozhàn Táiwān zuì gāo de gāoshān, ér měitiān mànpǎo yì xiǎoshí, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì.
text.english: In order to take on Taiwan's highest mountain peak, he jogs an hour every day to build his stamina.

text.traditional: 他為了讓生病的母親快點兒好起來，而學習做一些對身體健康有好處的菜。
text.simplified: 他为了让生病的母亲快点儿好起来，而学习做一些对身体健康有好处的菜。
text.pinyin: Tā wèile ràng shēngbìng de mǔqīn kuài diǎnr hǎo qǐlái, ér xuéxí zuò yìxiē duì shēntǐ jiànkāng yǒu hǎochù de cài.
text.english: To help his sick mother get better sooner, he learned to cook some dishes that are good for her health.

grammarPages.explanationEnglish: The clause following 為了 explains the objective to be achieved. The clause following 而 shows in what manner the objective was achieved.
